title: Non-staff admin access test never authenticates the regular user
reasoning: The regular user is created with username regular@example.com, but the non-staff access test logs in with username regular. That login fails, so the request is made anonymously and the test only proves unauthenticated users are redirected, duplicating the login-required test instead of covering authenticated non-staff denial.
recommendation: Log in with username regular@example.com and assert the login succeeds before requesting the admin changelist.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing test has the right scenario name, but because authentication silently fails it does not exercise the non-staff authenticated path.
suggestedRegressionTest: Update test_admin_list_view_requires_staff to assert self.client.login(username='regular@example.com', password='regularpass123') is True before making the request.
minimumFixScope: Fix the username in notifications/tests/test_promo_email_admin.py and add an assertion that the test setup authenticated the regular user.
